content.short: Cardano NFT platform powered by Kaizen Crypto. Adventure awaits as the battle for the crypto space unfolds. Level up and earn rewards.
content.description:
Lovelace Saga is a play to earn blockchain game built on Cardano. The in-game rewards mechanics are based on the tokens contained within the ecosystem. As the platform grows in users, so will the intrinsic value of the tokens.

These tokens held as NFTs will represent in-game items and playable characters which will be tradable in the marketplace. Battle using your favorite character and level up to earn rewards.
